results.title: Model runtime stopped: chat and RAG fail fast with a clear error, then recover
results.detail: chat failed in 1s with "The model provider failed to respond. Please try again."; RAG → 502; nothing charged; chat answered again after restart

results.title: Postgres stopped: readiness says so, requests fail fast, and the API recovers without a restart
results.detail: authenticated read → 503 in 0s; liveness stayed 200; recovered without restarting the API

results.title: Worker stopped: queued work waits, durably, and completes when a worker returns
results.detail: pending for 20 s with no worker; succeeded after the worker restarted

results.title: The image process killed mid-generation: the image fails honestly and is not charged
results.detail: settled "failed" with "Image generation failed. The server log records why, against this id."; not charged

results.title: The MCP server process killed: it is marked down and its tools removed; reconnect restores it
results.detail: marked "failed" with 0 tools ("Not connected"); reconnect restored 14 tools
